architecture: Exact same V3 B1/B2/B3/B5 formulas frozen in GB1 preregistration.
blind_split: Use repository fold_id: 0 visible, 1 hidden; do not alter based on labels.
candidate_generation: Use only substitutions present in visible rows. Enumerate triples if tractable; deterministic beam=5000 for higher mutation counts; hidden membership is forbidden before freeze.
primary_metrics: pooled hidden Spearman on generated candidates
success_rule: Fresh orthogonal support requires B3/B5 to beat B1 and B2 on at least 3 of 5 primary metrics, have top-100 enrichment >1, and show clear degradation after visible-label shuffle. If candidate/hidden matching is sparse, mark the test non-evaluable rather than pass.
